pages.text:
PERSONALISE
YOUR VEHICLE
The following pages take you through a logical series of steps
to make your Defender Works V8 Edition suit your lifestyle.
There are several choices: from selecting your body style to exterior
and interior colours, finishes and other detailed touches.
1. CHOOSE YOUR BODY STYLE
Select maximum manoeuvrability or maximum space
2. CHOOSE YOUR COLOUR
A wide range on offer to express yourself
3. CHOOSE YOUR WHEELS
There’s a range of styles, each one designed to complement
the bold exterior
4. CHOOSE YOUR INTERIOR
Personalise your interior with the ideal colour combination
of seats, materials and your preferred finisher

2. CHOOSE YOUR
COLOUR
– Choose from 6 exterior colour options
– Satin option on Corris Grey and Indus Silver
(Black parts remain gloss)
– Black pack as standard
– Santorini Black Roof
– Santorini Black grille and headlamp surrounds
– Santorini Black wheel arch eyebrows
Corris Grey – Satin Option Indus Silver – Satin Option Santorini Black Fuji White Bering Grey Roma Red
